observation: Re-opening or refreshing a Google 'sorry' page directly results in an empty or broken CAPTCHA state.
technical_detail: Google reCAPTCHA tokens are session-tied and single-use. Manual refresh or tool-based re-opening of the same 'continue' URL invalidates the token, leading to an empty 'list-elements' result.
learned_rule: NEVER refresh or re-open a CAPTCHA page once triggered. Solve it within the active session flow using persistent browser contexts.
next_action: Trigger a completely fresh CAPTCHA by initiating a new search query that provokes anti-bot detection.
